about_the_game:
L.O.S.T. is an intense cooperative survival action game where up to four players are trapped in a deadly location.
Your only chance is to complete the mission, hold back enemy waves, and survive until evacuation arrives.

Every session is unique: your teamwork and decisions will determine whether you make it out alive — or remain forever lost.

Features

  • 🎮 4-player online co-op — survive together with friends.

  • 🚁 Different escape scenarios — refuel a helicopter, repair a ship, or reach the bus in time.

  • ⚔️ Fight enemy hordes — use weapons, abilities, and tactics to push back.

  • 🔦 Scavenge & cooperate — gather supplies, repair transport, and protect your team.

  • 🕒 Fast-paced sessions — time is limited, and every choice matters.

👉 Add L.O.S.T. to your wishlist and be among the first to experience the thrill of survival!
